title: Writes stalling on the main store
description: Everything touching the ledger store hangs; long-running transactions are holding locks and autovacuum cannot keep up.

title: Read replica serving old data
description: Users see outdated profile info because the standby is minutes behind the primary.

title: Clients cannot reach us from one ISP
description: Customers on a single carrier get connection timeouts; traceroutes die at the peering point.

title: Name lookups slow inside the cluster
description: Internal service names take seconds to resolve and sometimes fail entirely.

title: Workers keep getting killed and restarting
description: Kernel logs show the process was killed for exceeding its memory limit; usage climbs for hours before each kill.

title: Runtime pauses growing longer
description: Stop-the-world garbage collection now takes seconds and the heap never shrinks.

title: Nodes running hot
description: Processors are at their ceiling and the run queue is long; requests are queueing behind compute-heavy jobs.

title: Latency tied to throttled containers
description: Containers hit their CPU quota constantly and get throttled, stretching response times.

title: Writes failing on the storage node
description: Applications cannot create files; df reports 100% usage on the data mount.

title: Volume nearly out of room
description: The data volume is at 97% and filling quickly because compaction is not reclaiming blocks.

title: Broke right after we shipped
description: Everything was fine until version 5.2 went out an hour ago; errors started during the rollout.

title: Reverting last night's change fixes it
description: The behavior started with last night's config push; reverting it on staging resolves the problem.

title: Odd spike of failed sign-ins from many IPs
description: A credential stuffing pattern against the login endpoint with thousands of attempts per minute.

title: Customer files exposed publicly
description: A misconfigured bucket policy let anyone read customer documents; access logs show external downloads.

title: Card processor returning errors
description: Authorization calls to the card processor are failing; their status page lists an ongoing incident.

title: Maps vendor throttling us
description: The geocoding provider is rate limiting our requests and lookups fall back to stale data.
